messages:
Mia: Quick sync — need a tight cadence for the marketplace launch next month. Main pillars: cloud listings (AWS, GCP), hardware partner verification (vendor test image + badge), SI integration readiness (test harness + run slots), and joint announcements (press, blog, landing).

Omar: Can we commit to concrete cutoffs? e.g., marketing assets final by Tue 2025-05-06, SI playbooks done by 2025-05-08, marketplace drafts 72h before publish.

Rachel: I can lock an embargo window. Prefer Wed AM for press + Thu for the blog. Partners need visibility — @mia can you confirm partner preferences?

Jaspreet: SI dev/test slots available 2025-05-06 & 2025-05-07. We need a sample tenant + API key from each SI and vendor-provided test image/config by EOD 2025-05-03.

Mia: Partner ask: hardware vendors must supply a validated test image and a short verification statement to appear on the landing. @eli can you mock badge options? Also add an opt-in checkbox for partners on the landing form.

Eli: Will draft 3 badge variants (SVG, light/dark) by tomorrow. Suggest a small tooltip copy: "Verified on Redwood inference runtime".

Rachel: Press plan: share embargo doc with partners by Monday. Draft is in drive: https://example.com/launch-embargo — please review comments.

Omar: Marketplace notes: AWS listing requires an account manager sign-off 72h before; GCP needs legal review for the partner offering. Ensure SKU mapping and pricing guidance submitted early.

Jaspreet: For SI integrations, Ill publish a short "integration smoke test" checklist (gist) with steps, expected responses, and failure modes. Will include sample curl commands and test data.

Mia: Action items recap:
- Marketing (Rachel): finalize press + blog by 2025-05-06
- Eng (Omar/Jaspreet): landing + partner opt-in + badge + integration smoke tests by 2025-05-04
- SI partners: run tests on 2025-05-06/07; provide tenant/API keys
- Hardware vendors: deliver verification image + statement by 2025-05-03
- Legal: marketplace terms review by 2025-05-05
Ill update the shared doc with owners and trackers.

deploy-bot: Reminder: staging cutover deploy window scheduled 2025-05-04 02:00-04:00 UTC.

Rachel: Also request partner quotes for the blog — ideally 2: one SI, one hardware partner. If a partner cant commit to a quote we'll use logo + link as fallback.

Mia: Ill ping partners now and flag owners. If anyone hits a hard blocker, mark it in the shared sheet so we can assess go/no-go.

Omar: Also add a short rollback runbook in case the marketplace listing gets stuck or fails validation. Need a rollback owner.

Jaspreet: Ill own the rollback playbook and post the runbook in #release-war-room after drafting.

Rachel: Perfect — reconvene Monday 09:30 PT for final go/no-go. :white_check_mark: 

Mia: Thanks all — will post updates in the doc and tag owners for the outstanding deliverables. :thumbsup:
